description: Pure parser (no fetching). Given HTML plus optional response headers and a sitemap entry for the same URL, extracts every freshness marker on the page — HTTP Last-Modified, sitemap lastmod, JSON-LD dateModified/datePublished (including @graph), OpenGraph article:modified_time/published_time, meta updated/dc.date.modified/dcterms.modified/itemprop dateModified, and the first labelled visible date (Last updated / Updated / Published). Returns per-source ISO dates, the freshest source, cross-source agreement spread, and heuristic flags (stale year in title, suspicious future date, only-published-not-modified, none-at-all). Powers the geo-aeo-readiness skill's freshness check — `Last-Modified` headers and `dateModified` JSON-LD are weighted heavily for AI grounding eligibility.

headers.description: Response headers as a plain object with lowercased keys (e.g. {"last-modified": "..."})

sitemapEntry.description: Parsed sitemap entry for this URL, e.g. {"lastmod": "2026-04-15"}

url.description: URL the HTML was fetched from (for context)

name: parse_freshness_signals
